title: Surrey RCMP probing death of man in custody
article: The Mounties in Surrey are investigating the death of a man who was being held in the Surrey RCMP cells.
Integrated homicide investigation team spokesman Corporal Dale Carr said 50-year-old Cecil Edward McKenna was found unconscious in the cells on Sunday morning.
Cpl. Carr said Mr. McKenna was intoxicated when he was picked up early on Saturday evening for causing a disturbance on transit property.
